## ⚡ Improved

- **The page's scripts and stylesheets are pinned whatever their tag's letter case.** The build adds an integrity hash to every one of them and stops on an inline script, and an uppercase `<SCRIPT>` no longer slips past that check.
- **Updated:** GlimStone 4.3.7, Rive's canvas runtime 2.50.0 for the castle, Node 24.22.3 for the build.
